question: What event at the time of bodily death is marked as decisive?
premises: The moment of bodily fall is specified.
The skull is said to be split at that time.
The statement is addressed to the goddess.
inference: At the fall of the body, the splitting of the skull marks that decisive moment.
uncertainties: The fused form kapālambhidyate is read as kapālam + bhidyate.
plain_english: O goddess, when the body falls and the skull is split, then that moment occurs.
